morphology.pattern_note: 英语常见读音为单音节，起首/st/保留，词尾双写gg不表示两个独立的/g/。不按马来语构词拆分；包内音节字段保持null。

senses.zh_definition: 斯塔格：英语姓氏；其具体人物、机构或其他专名所指须由上下文确定。
senses.en_definition: An English surname; any particular bearer or namesake must be identified from context.
senses.ms_definition: Nama keluarga Inggeris; individu atau entiti tertentu yang menggunakan nama ini dikenal pasti melalui konteks.
senses.nuances: 属专有名词，正文写作Stagg。不得把它直接释为马来语rusa或英语普通名词stag，也不能仅凭词形认定某位人物。马来语释义为编写说明，并非DBP原文；以下为人物全名示例，不是已核定频率的词汇搭配。

etymology.historical_story: Stagg belongs to an English surname tradition in which nicknames became inherited family names. Its historical source is Middle English stag or stagge, associated with a male deer and, in some dialects, a young horse. An animal comparison could suggest strength, but modern bearers inherit a surname rather than an animal description. [Dictionary of American Family Names via FamilySearch](https://www.familysearch.org/en/surname?surname=stagg)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: Stagg与英语stag同音：用“雄鹿”帮助记发音和历史联系，但现代姓名仍译作“斯塔格”，不能直接译成“雄鹿”。
